method: Native front and close side views sampled across the complete 900-action demo, plus detailed release frames 680,700,720,730,740,760,780,840,900 and source-verified independent trace audit. Dream front and policy-camera samples cover the full 1,000-action run, with a matching independent audit.
demo: Both open hands approach the separate metal housings, close on them, lift the flexible band around the wrist, align and insert the pin, lower the closed clasp, open and withdraw. At45s both hands are visibly clear and the closed bracelet remains around the form. Native trace confirms 5.5 s released retention and no catch-break/band-integrity event.
limitations: Segmented leather and uncalibrated bending/friction. Finite 30 N / 0.20 Nm spring-catch approximation engages after measured physical entry; privileged object-pose feedback drives ordinary demo arm commands only. The held clasp is partly occluded by fingers; complementary views and the final close-up establish closure and release.
dream: All 1,000 actions were recorded. Front and policy-camera samples throughout the 50 s rollout show arm motion without grasping or closing either clasp end; the bracelet remains in its starting layout. Policy-camera RGB is coherent. Independent native-pose audit agrees with 0.0.
